about: Agent Entry Suite S1 (agent-entry.json, verbs first). Byte-pinned compile vectors: compileDeclaration(declaration, { version }) must produce a contract whose canonicalJSON equals canonicalJSON(contract) below, byte for byte, every time. skillsFromOffers(declaration) must produce skills[] deep-equal to skills below, in order.

rules.unknownVerb: accepted as a pass-through with NO defaults: no effect, ask or then unless the offer declares them; door.receipt defaults to false
rules.effect: offer.effect may raise the verb default (effectOrder); lowering it is refused
rules.ask: offer.ask may raise the floor of the resolved effect (askOrder); below the floor is refused
rules.then: "door" when offer.then is "door", or page.then is "door", or the resolved effect is in thenDoorByDefault; absent when offer.then is "none"; absent otherwise
rules.contract: { v: 1, name: entry.name, origins, version, offers, facts (only when declared), hash }
rules.origins: origin of entry.baseUrl first, then "https://" + lowercased entry.domains[i], in order, without duplicates
rules.compiledOffer: { id, verb, of, about, input, effect?, ask?, then?, page?: { on, do }, door?: { reply, receipt, url? } } - page.then is folded into then
rules.hash: lowercase hex sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of canonicalJSON(contract without hash)
rules.served: every contract is served as the UTF-8 bytes of canonicalJSON(contract)
rules.skill: { id, name: id, description: about, tags: [verb, of], examples } - examples[0] is about; when input is non-empty, examples[1] is verb + " " + of + " " + canonicalJSON of { <field>: "<" + type + ">" } over the input keys sorted
rules.checkoutUrl: a same-origin path: starts with "/" and not "//"
